title: electron placement knowledge base, one JSON record per line
description: What plan-place tried, on what, and what it gained. A knowledge base is a directory (3RDBIN/placement_kb init) holding sessions.jsonl and trials.jsonl, written only by appending. Records carry no design, module or library name: a design is a salted hash (the salt is private to the knowledge base), a module is the structural fingerprint 3RDBIN/placement_kb fingerprint computes (cell-type counts, port widths and children's fingerprints), so the same module in a later RTL drop matches without its name. Names for the owner's own reading go in the knowledge base's private alias file, never in a record. Times in seconds, timing in ns, lengths in um.

metrics.description: Timing as the predictor sees it: planned repeaters and sizing (photon_server REPEATED + size), split by blame.

tns_logic.description: TNS of what still fails with no wire

tns_placement.description: what wires cost: with-wire minus no-wire

module_features.description: The owner blame pointed at. Structural numbers only.

copies.description: instances of it in the design

charge_share.description: its share of the placement TNS blame charged, 0..1

oneOf.title: session: one placement explored, and the conditions it was explored in

session.description: unique id, referenced by its trials

technology.description: node and cell family as a salted hash, or a public name (nangate)

noise_tns.description: TNS spread of a control re-place in this session (fraction of TNS)

oneOf.title: trial: one action tried on one owner, and what it did

owner_kind.description: blame's kind for the owner acted on; none for a control

partners.description: for an arrangement, the block pair

params.description: e.g. {cut: 'V(a H(b c))' with fingerprints for names} or {rows_along: 'y'}

seconds.description: what the try cost: placement plus prediction

verdict.description: accepted: better beyond the session's noise; noise: within it; invalid: the try was broken
